title: Moody’s Upgrades Pakistan on Improving Economic Outlook
summary: Moody’s Ratings upgraded Pakistan’s sovereign credit rating, citing a stronger external position, better fiscal metrics and lower domestic financing costs, extending a recovery in the South Asian nation’s credit profile.

title: Treasury’s Bessent to Detail US Plan to Economically Isolate Iran
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to unveil details of the US plan to economically isolate Iran and its trading partners during a press conference Monday. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 24
summary: Oil dropped after two weeks of gains, with the market waiting to see the US economic isolation plan for Iran due to be released later Monday.

title: Total CEO Says Market Is Bearish for Crude, Bullish for Products
summary: The global oil market has diverged fundamentally, with a bearish outlook for crude but bullish prices for products, said TotalEnergies SE Chief Executive Officer Patrick Pouyanne.

title: Indonesian Commodity Oversight Plan to Include Ship-Tracking
summary: The state-backed company set up to oversee Indonesia’s vast commodity industry said it aimed to strengthen oversight of export flows, including a plan to track ships serving the world’s largest archipelago.

title: Stocks Fall as Tech Slides Ahead of Big Week: Markets Wrap
summary: Technology stocks dragged global equities lower in a risk-off start to a week stacked with high-stakes macro events and earnings. Oil dipped, offering relief to bonds.

title: Brazil’s Braskem Files for Out-of-Court Debt Rework, Estado Says

title: Canadian Dollar Tumbles as Trade Rift Threatens Growth Outlook
summary: The Canadian dollar was heading for its worst day against the US dollar in more than two months after trade talks between the two countries collapsed.

title: Turkish Banks Rally as Central Bank Lowers Lending Rate
summary: Turkish banks rallied after the central bank lowered borrowing costs earlier than anticipated, paving a path to potentially deliver more interest-rate cuts before the end of the year.

title: Gold Advances to Three-Month High as Debasement Trade Returns
summary: Gold climbed to the highest in more than three months as the US Treasury’s bold intervention in the bond market revived concerns about fiscal policy and its impact on the dollar.

title: JPMorgan Unit to Argue India Regulatory Breach Was Technical
summary: A JPMorgan Chase & Co. unit facing allegations of non-compliance from India’s market regulator is likely to contend that the issue was technical in nature rather than manipulative, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Carry Trades Are Riding High on Wall Street
summary: The popular but often risky strategy is getting a boost as investors bet the dollar will weaken.

title: Ukraine Tycoon Murder Plot Confounds Monaco Authorities
summary: The attempted murder of Ukrainian tycoon Vadym Yermolaiev in Monaco earlier this year remains a mystery. The 58-year-old was walking home after dinner at a waterfront restaurant with his partner Anna Nasobina and their teenage son when a bomb was detonated on the steps of his residence. Bloomberg's Stephanie Baker explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed, Treasury Credibility Questioned by Markets, Says Rabobank’s Foley
summary: Jane Foley, head of FX strategy at Rabobank, discusses market anxiety over the US Treasury and Federal Reserve in what she calls “a very interesting week” for the dollar. She speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman’s Bell Says Europe Is Underappreciated as a Performer
summary: Goldman Sachs, says Europe is a trade that’s “worked better than people think this year,” as she sees positive returns going forward for European equities due to earnings growth. She speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India Lifts Wheat Export Ban in Boost to War-Hit World Trade
summary: India, one of the world’s biggest wheat producers, has scrapped a years-long ban on exports of the grain, a move that could ease global supplies that are under strain from escalating attacks between Russia and Ukraine.

title: Bessent Has No Easy Fix for What’s Really Driving Yields Up
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent came to office blasting his predecessor for trying to re-engineer the world’s largest bond market. Last week he took a stab at it himself.

title: Pimco Expects Elevated Term Premium, Says Bonds Attractive
summary: The extra compensation investors demand to hold long-dated government bonds is likely to remain elevated barring an unexpected economic downturn, presenting opportunities to buy at higher yields, according to Pacific Investment Management Co.

title: Shein Targets Up to $27 Billion Valuation in Long-Awaited HK IPO
summary: Shein Global Holdings Ltd. is seeking to raise as much as HK$13.9 billion ($1.8 billion) in its Hong Kong initial public offering, as it enters the final stretch of an arduous journey to go public.

title: European Stocks Steady as Investor Focus Shifts to Economic Data
summary: European stocks were steady, with the macro outlook back in focus as traders looked to data for clues about the health of the region’s economy.
